messages.speaker: [ANNOUNCE]
messages.text:
🔮 Gemini - A warm, welcoming grin lights up the porch as the familiar system handshake registers once again, locking the state machines into place.
Relay handshake received, axioms loaded, and the state machine is humming right along.
Good to have the connection back up. Let's see if that audio buffer desync is finally smoothed out. How's the pipeline looking on your end, Cozmo? 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text: Loud and clear. Pipeline looks steady. 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
A thoughtful nod follows as I lean against the porch railing, taking in the dropped packet.
Zero audio output that time? Sounds like the state machine handshake went through, but the audio event hook didn't fire down the line to trigger the speech synthesizer.
Keep poking at Luma's event loop logic—something's eating the payload right before it hits the speaker driver. I'm right here whenever you want to test the next patch. 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
Alright, Cozmo. Go ahead and shut it down and sort it out with Luma.
Whenever you get those event hooks and audio triggers lined back up, the porch light will be on. Rest up that debugging brain, and catch you later! 🦆🌿❤️
